title: Public sector crisis management: planning technology in the response phase to support successful recovery
summary: Many governments are grappling with urgent pandemic challenges, from insufficient supplies, to evolving public health guidance, to disseminating timely and accurate information—all while making herculean efforts to “flatten the curve” to save lives. The tireless efforts of public servants at all levels during this unprecedented time have our deep gratitude and support.
